property_summary: For any nonzero deposit, after the owner calls withdrawAll the call succeeds and the contract's entire Ether (address(c).balance) is transferred out to the owner, leaving balance 0; the mutant's withdrawAll transfers nothing, so the balance stays nonzero (or the success/behavior diverges) for nonzero deposits.
change_summary: Remove the call to withdraw so withdrawAll no longer transfers any funds out.
